main.remarks: Denies issuer-only keys when either the issuing AccessManager or Tool does not match the current evaluator.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether issuer-only key claims match the current AccessManager and Tool.
method.returns: Deny when an issuer-only key does not match both current issuer identities; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether issuer-only key claims match the current AccessManager and Tool.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when an issuer-only key does not match both current issuer identities; otherwise allow.
